notice: Official Agricultural Credit & Disaster Relief Guidelines based on PMFBY, RBI Kisan Credit Card (KCC), and Tamil Nadu State Disaster Response Fund (SDRF).

damage_schemes.severity_trigger: Flooded area > 30% or SAR Backscatter drop > 3 dB with >150mm rainfall

schemes.name: PM Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) Mid-Season Adversity Claim
schemes.coverage_amount: Up to ₹30,000 per acre (based on verified loss percentage)
schemes.eligibility: Crops submerged for > 72 hours; loss verified by satellite SAR or joint survey.
requirements: Land Patta / Chitta / Adangal (Land ownership or tenancy record)
Bank Passbook copy (linked to Aadhaar for DBT)
AgriShield Satellite Damage Verification Report (attached automatically)
Sowing declaration / Crop insurance enrollment receipt
schemes.where_to_apply: Nearest Primary Agricultural Cooperative Credit Society (PACCS), Common Service Center (CSC), or National Crop Insurance Portal (pmfby.gov.in)
schemes.first_step: STEP 1: Download your AgriShield Satellite Proof PDF and notify your Village Administrative Officer (VAO) or call 14447 (Kisan Call Center) within 72 hours of flood event.

schemes.name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Emergency Debt Rescheduling & Fresh Line of Credit
schemes.type: Restructured Agricultural Loan + Emergency Fresh Input Loan
schemes.coverage_amount: Reschedule existing loan for 3 to 5 years + Fresh working capital up to ₹50,000
schemes.eligibility: Farmers holding active KCC affected by declared natural calamity (>33% crop loss).
requirements: District Collectorate / Tahsildar Calamity Notification Certificate
schemes.where_to_apply: Your existing lending Bank branch (SBI Agri, Indian Bank, Canara Bank) or District Central Cooperative Bank (DCCB)
schemes.first_step: STEP 1: Visit your loan-issuing bank branch with the AgriShield SAR Satellite Flood report and request Form-B for Natural Calamity Loan Conversion.

schemes.name: State Disaster Response Fund (SDRF) Input Subsidy Grant
schemes.eligibility: Paddy farmers in Cauvery Delta blocks facing severe crop lodging or root rot from water stagnation.
schemes.where_to_apply: Taluk Office / Revenue Inspector / Block Assistant Director of Agriculture (ADA)
schemes.first_step: STEP 1: Submit Form-8 at the Taluk Tahsildar office with plot survey number and the AgriShield damage report.

damage_schemes.severity_trigger: NDVI drop > 15% during vegetative stage with rainfall deficit

schemes.name: KCC Contingent Irrigation & Input Credit
schemes.coverage_amount: Up to ₹40,000 per acre for borewell recharge, diesel pump rental, or micro-irrigation
schemes.eligibility: Farmers with verified NDVI vegetative stress dip due to delayed canal release.
requirements: AgriShield NDVI timeline showing stress dip
schemes.where_to_apply: Primary Agricultural Cooperative Society (PACCS) or Lead District Bank
schemes.first_step: STEP 1: Submit an urgent micro-irrigation credit request to PACCS attaching the NDVI timeline proof.

damage_schemes.severity_trigger: Humidity > 85% for 3 days leading to blast lesions and yield loss

schemes.name: Emergency Plant Protection & Bio-Fungicide Input Subsidy
schemes.coverage_amount: Up to ₹15,000 per acre (50% input subsidy on approved bio-control agents)
schemes.interest_rate: 0% for government subsidized bio-agents; 4% for credit component
schemes.eligibility: Paddy farmers following integrated pest management protocols.
requirements: Field photos / AgriShield disease risk advisory receipt
schemes.where_to_apply: Block Agricultural Extension Center (Uzhavar Sandhai / Agriculture Department Depot)
schemes.first_step: STEP 1: Take AgriShield blast alert record to the Block Agriculture Extension Officer for subsidised Tricyclazole or Pseudomonas distribution.

schemes.name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Seasonal Production Credit
schemes.coverage_amount: Up to ₹3,00,000 (₹35,000 per acre for paddy)
schemes.interest_rate: 4% effective interest rate (with 3% prompt repayment incentive)
schemes.eligibility: All landholders and verified tenant farmers.
schemes.where_to_apply: Any Nationalized Bank, Regional Rural Bank (RRB), or PACCS
schemes.first_step: STEP 1: Apply online via JanSamarth portal (jansamarth.in) or visit your nearest branch with land documents.

schemes.name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF) Farm Modernization Loan
schemes.type: Term Loan for Post-Harvest Assets & Equipment
schemes.coverage_amount: Up to ₹2 Crore (3% interest subvention for 7 years)
schemes.interest_rate: 3% interest subvention below prevailing bank rate
schemes.eligibility: Farmers, FPOs, and self-help groups creating bund protection, dryers, or storage.
schemes.where_to_apply: AIF Online Portal (agriinfra.dac.gov.in) or Commercial Banks
schemes.first_step: STEP 1: Register on the AIF portal and select your preferred lending bank.

common_documents.name: Aadhaar Card
common_documents.desc: Identity verification and Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) linkage

common_documents.name: Land Record (Patta / Chitta / Adangal)
common_documents.desc: Proof of land cultivation and survey number

common_documents.name: Bank Passbook
common_documents.desc: Active bank account linked to NPCI Aadhaar payment bridge

common_documents.name: AgriShield Satellite Damage Certificate
common_documents.desc: Independent Sentinel-1/2 earth observation evidence PDF

common_documents.name: Crop Insurance Enrollment Receipt
common_documents.desc: PMFBY premium debit advice or village sowing registry
